messages.author: merchant
messages.text: Hi Ritu, Sandeep, here is our annual plan: website fixes, search marketing, social media and monthly reporting. It comes to ₹1,20,000 plus GST for the year.

messages.author: buyer
messages.text: Ritu: Thanks Meera. We love the reporting format you showed us. The team is keen.

messages.author: buyer
messages.text: Sandeep: Honestly, we have another quote. ₹80,000 for the whole year, same deliverables.

messages.author: merchant
messages.text: Could you share what it covers? I'd like to compare like for like.

messages.author: buyer
messages.text: Sandeep: Website, SEO and social posts. Not sure about reporting, they said it is basic updates.

messages.author: buyer
messages.text: Ritu: We don't want to switch only for price, but ₹80,000 is what is approved for us this quarter. We need website fixes, search marketing, social media and monthly reporting.

messages.author: buyer
messages.text: Sandeep: If you can come to ₹80,000, I can sign today.

messages.author: merchant
messages.text: Let me check what is possible and come back to you.

messages.author: buyer
messages.text: Ritu: Even if it is less than a full year, we can look at it. We just can't go above ₹80,000 this quarter.

messages.author: buyer
messages.text: Sandeep: And please send a payment link, not a long contract. We pay by UPI.
